tex_content.html:
\begin{notation} \end{notation}

Let $M$ be a smooth manifold and $S\subseteq M$ a smooth submanifold. The notation $f\in C^\infty (S)$ means that $f:S\to \mathbb R$ is smooth with respect to the manifold structure on $S$; it does not assert that $f$ locally extends to a smooth function on $M$. \end{notation}
